name: Out-of-Core PLY to RAD LOD Conversion
definition: A file conversion pipeline that processes large PLY Gaussian splat files into tiled, chunked RAD LOD format using an out-of-core bucketed builder to avoid RAM exhaustion.
summary: Out-of-Core PLY to RAD LOD Conversion processes large Gaussian splat files into tiled RAD LOD format using a streaming architecture that avoids RAM exhaustion by dynamically selecting a bucketed builder based on estimated memory footprint.
